heroTitle: Tools for pastors, pioneers, and multiplying churches.
heroDescription: A growing library of practical resources to help leaders discover calling, discern next steps, develop people, and deploy toward church multiplication.
featuredDescription: These core resources are designed to help leaders take the next faithful step toward multiplication.

resources.title: Discover: Church Multiplication 101
resources.description: A first-step track for pastors and pioneers exploring the biblical, practical, and strategic foundations of church multiplication.

resources.title: Church Pioneer Vision Guide
resources.description: A planning guide for pioneers and sending churches to clarify vision, mission, disciple-making approach, timeline, budget, and partnership.

resources.title: Discernment Center
resources.description: An interactive gathering designed to help potential pioneers clarify calling, assess readiness, and receive wise feedback.
